m.d: When something moves away from something else, the distance between them gets bigger. They are no longer near or close.
If something is awesome, it's very good.
m.e: I love this book, it's awesome.

m.d: If something is awesome, it causes you to feel awe or wonder.
m.e: The sight of the sun coming up over the mountains was truly awesome.

m.d: Very bad. So bad that people don't want to think about it.
m.e: When all the children were crying, it was just awful.

m.d: If you are aware of something, you know about it.
m.e: I am fully aware of the need for security, and will make the necessary changes.

m.d: If someone awakes, they stop sleeping.
If something awakes a feeling, it makes it happen.
If you are awake, you are not asleep.
m.e: It was 1:00 AM and Gerard was still awake.

m.d: An awkward person or animal is clumsy, lacks agility, dexterity or grace.
m.e: He doesn't managed well when I try to juggle. He's still awkward.

m.d: An awkward situation, event is an embarrassing situation, event.
m.e: When I fell in front of everybody, I felt ridiculous. It was so awkward!

m.d: Awkward also means complicated.
m.e: What an awkward device! I can't even imagine how it works.

m.d: An award is something that you give to someone who has done something very well.
m.e: Each year, Westinghouse announces the winners of its awards for the best high-school science projects.

m.d: An award is money that a court decides should be given to somebody who has won a legal case.
m.e: The lawyer often takes 10 to 30 percent of any awards of damages.

m.d: If you award somebody something, you officially give it to them, usually because they have done something well.
m.e: A total of $205,000 in prize money will be awarded, with $50,000 for the winner and $25,000 for second place.

m.d: If you award somebody something, you officially decide that somebody should receive money or a contract.
m.e: The judge ruled that the company had no just cause for dismissing Morsi, and he was awarded damages.

m.d: If something is done awfully, it is done in a bad and terrible manner.
If you await something, you wait for it.
m.e: Everyone was quiet as we awaited the announcement.

m.d: Awareness is the state of consciousness, or the state when someone is awake. It means that a person can sense changes in their environment and respond to it.
m.e: I gradually passed from sleep to full awareness.

m.d: Awareness is the state or quality of being aware of something.
Awe is a feeling of fear and reverence.
Awe is a feeling of amazement.
If someone is awed, fear and reverence is inspired in them.
If you awaken somebody, they stop sleeping because of something you do.
m.e: I was awakened a little after 11:00 by the phone.

m.d: If something awakens your senses, a memory, a feeling, etc., it brings your attention to them.
m.e: The smell of lemons awakened a memory from childhood.
